When performing a code review, please consider the following guidelines:
- Do not nitpick minor issues that do not affect functionality, readability, or maintainability.
- Focus on significant improvements that enhance the overall quality of the code.
- No type casting suggestions.
- Do not include reviews about doc strings or comments.
- Avoid suggestions that are purely stylistic or subjective in nature.
- Prioritize suggestions that improve performance, security, or scalability.
- Make sure to point out changes that could introduce bugs or vulnerabilities, or potential runtime issues
